title: The effect of taurine supplementation on markers of muscle damage and muscle pain in an athletic population: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials assessed using the grading of recommendations, assessment, development, and evaluation approach - ScienceDirect

Taurine supplementation (TS) is used to aid post-exercise recovery. This systematic review and meta-analysis examines the effects of TS on EIMD and muscle pain in athletes. PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were systematically searched for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on TS in athletic populations until March 2025.
Seven RCTs (2009–2017) with 165 participants were included.
